title: MigrationSummary
description: Schema definition for DevOps Migration Agent summary report

source_file.description: Path or identifier of the source workflow file

jobs_count.description: Total number of jobs in the workflow

direct_mappings_count.description: Number of actions mapped directly to native Azure DevOps tasks

partial_mappings_count.description: Number of actions mapped with configuration adjustments or warnings

manual_mappings_count.description: Number of actions requiring manual script or extension migration

unsupported_count.description: Number of actions that cannot be ported to Azure DevOps

unknown_count.description: Number of custom or unrecognized third-party actions

secrets_count.description: Count of distinct secrets referenced in the workflow

has_terraform.description: Indicates whether Terraform configurations were evaluated

estimated_effort_hours.description: Estimated engineer-hours to complete migration and validation
